title: Cyber for AI at SemEval-2025 Task 4: Forgotten but Not Lost: The Balancing Act of Selective Unlearning in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of selective unlearning (data removal) in LLMs for the SemEval-2025 competition. While it mentions ethics and bias in the introduction as motivations for unlearning, the actual research and evaluation are centered on model performance, privacy metrics (MIA), and utility retention (MMLU), rather than benchmarking religion, ethics, or moral values.
